:::{#def-sensitivity}
#### Sensitivity

Suppose a minimization problem (@def-minimization-problem)
depends on a vector $\vecf{b} \in \reals^m$,
and let $f^*(\vecf{b})$ be its minimum value, as a function of $\vecf{b}$.
When the [gradient](vector-calculus.qmd#def-vector-derivative) $\deriv{\vecf{b}} f^*(\vecf{b})$ exists,
it is the **sensitivity** of the minimum value to $\vecf{b}$:
by the definition of a [partial derivative](vector-calculus.qmd#def-partial-derivative), its entry $i$ is the limit
as a change in $b_i$ alone shrinks to $0$,
of the resulting change in the minimum value divided by the change in $b_i$.

:::
